text: RGTI is down 18% and a massive 52% off its high with declining revenue and no profitability — this thesis is broken, so sell and redeploy the capital somewhere stronger.
RDW has missed earnings four straight quarters, is burning cash, and has 18% short interest betting against it — cut this loss at down 24% before it gets worse.
QBTS has no profits, 15.5% short interest, and consecutive earnings misses — trim this speculative position to a size you'd be comfortable losing entirely.
SKYT is up 72% and sitting at its 52-week high but the MACD just turned bearish — lock in some of that gain by trimming before momentum fades.
Microsoft is down 10% but the MACD has turned bullish and it's back above its 50-day average — this pullback in a world-class business is a good spot to add shares.
Meta trades at just 16.5 times earnings with 22% revenue growth and strong free cash flow — that's a rare combination of value and growth worth adding to.
Lockheed Martin is a blue-chip defense name with a reasonable PE of 16 and steady cash flow — a reliable compounder at a fair price deserves more capital.
RTX is down 17% and below its 50-day average, but defense spending tailwinds and solid fundamentals make this dip a buying opportunity for patient investors.
